psf_model: persisted CoaddPsf; same full-reference PSF used for half/noisy until variant PSFs are available
aggregation: median radius over nine PSF samples per patch and band
normalization: nonnegative PSF stamp sum; negative interpolation lobes clipped, fraction recorded per stamp
aperture: photutils exact circular pixel integration; geometric kernel center
fallback: If r10 contains no output pixel center, assign 4 to nearest floor(x+0.5), floor(y+0.5).
